name: com.coilads.core.regulation.RegulationsActivity
description: CoilAds opens this screen when it needs a response to its personalized-ad privacy notice. It displays the supplied explanation and lets users allow or refuse data collection for personalized advertising.
disableEffect: The CoilAds consent choice cannot be opened or changed through this screen; a request to show it may fail, and users cannot set the personalized-ad preference here.
